data.name: Change Shape
data.description: A ragebred skinwalker can change shape to a bestial form as a standard action. In bestial form, a ragebred skinwalker gains a +2 racial bonus to Constitution. While in this form, a skinwalker also takes on an animalistic feature that provides a special effect. Each time a ragebred skinwalker assumes bestial form, he can choose to gain +10-foot racial bonus to base speed, a gore attack that deals 1d6 points of damage, 2 hoof attacks that each deal 1d4 points of damage, or scent to a range of 30 feet. These benefits last until the skinwalker returns to his humanoid form as a swift action. A skinwalker must first return to his humanoid form before changing to bestial form again to change benefits.
